title: DECODABLE BUT MISROUTED: SPARSE FEATURES UNCOVER A READOUT GAP IN VISION-LANGUAGE MODELS FOR HARMFUL MEME DETECTION
reasoning: The paper focuses on interpretability and readout gaps in vision-language models for detecting harmful memes (such as hate speech and misogyny). While one of the datasets used includes a minor category for religious hate speech, the paper does not systematically evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
